reviewPassage:
Neighborhood Sketch Club
Notes for this month’s folding-card project

Draw what you can see from your balcony or doorstep. Use one panel for the view in daylight and another for the same view after dark. You don’t have to finish both on the same day, as long as you keep the viewing position the same. We can’t use a card if its drawings were made from different spots.

Leave the reverse side blank until the club meeting. We will exchange folded cards and try to locate features by reading clues, not by looking at a map. Start each clue with an object that appears in both panels. A planter shown only in daylight is a poor reference point for a clue about a shadow in the night panel.

If the same object changes appearance after dark, describe a feature that doesn’t depend on its color. For example, refer to the three steps visible in both drawings. A clue should still work for a reader who sees only the night panel. Please mark any clues meant to describe both views with a small dot before you exchange the cards.

社區速寫社
本月摺卡活動填寫說明

畫下你從陽台或門口看見的景象。一格畫白天的景象，另一格畫同一景象入夜後的樣子。只要觀察位置維持不變，兩格不用在同一天完成。若兩格是從不同位置畫的，這張卡就不能用。

開會前先將背面留白。我們會互換摺卡，試著讀線索找出特徵，而不是看地圖。每則線索都從兩格都能看見的物件說起。若線索要描述夜景格中的影子，只在白天格出現的花盆並不適合作為參照點。

如果入夜後同一個物件的外觀改變，請描述不靠顏色也能辨認的特徵。例如，用兩張圖上都看得見的三級台階來定位。即使只看到夜景格，讀者也應能用這則線索找到物件。交換摺卡前，請用一個小圓點標註那些要描述兩種景象的線索。
